name: backend-ms
description: DDD Microservices Architecture with gRPC, RabbitMQ, and API Gateway

scripts.install:all: for dir in services/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm install); fi; done
scripts.build:all: for dir in services/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"build"' "$dir/package.json"; then (cd "$dir" && npm run build); fi; done
scripts.test:all: for dir in services/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"test"' "$dir/package.json"; then echo "=== Testing $dir ===" && (cd "$dir" && npm test) || exit 1; fi; done
